reasons: Status is correctly recorded as 'missing': the cited fee provisions (§3(a)-(c)) contain no audit, inspection or verification mechanic, and nothing elsewhere in the supplied text grants Contractor such a right, so there is no existing clause that could be classified as compliant or a deviation.

The proposed new §3(d) is actionable and directionally correct for us as Customer: it first negates any Contractor audit right, then caps any right that a Statement of Work or law might supply at the preferred position (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, independent auditor under confidentiality, off-site only, no direct/remote/on-site system access, Vendor cost unless >5% underpayment). It concedes nothing and cannot be read as creating an audit right.

The gap being closed is genuine rather than theoretical: the Agreement contemplates SOWs adding 'additional terms and conditions' per engagement, so an express Agreement-level limit (which controls over conflicting SOW terms) has real value.

Comment is accurate, concise, in our voice, states what changed and why, and offers the fallback (15 days' notice / 10% threshold); deterministic checks (operation applies, frequency limited) pass and the drafting matches the redline guidance.

Priority note: silence already leaves us better off than the preferred position, so this is a prophylactic, low-priority ask rather than a live exposure — recommend downgrading severity and being prepared to drop it if raising audit invites the Contractor to negotiate broader rights.
